findings.reason: a node reading the body as authority would treat §4 as still deferred and not run, while a node reading the status runs now; the body must be reconciled with the release (or the release is premature).
findings.text: §4 still reads "Once §8's rewrite lands, and not before, this section re-runs …" and its done-when at line 79 ends "Deferred until §8 lands", yet the section is declared `implementable` (79c4ebbb) on the stated ground that "Both pulses now carry the renamed differential entries, so the redraw's trigger is met", and followup f-jsfi-004 records "jt60sa-pulse-ids §8 rewrote both pulses with the FL<L>-FL7 names (merged b406677c)" — so the body conditions the run on a trigger the plan elsewhere records as already met

findings.reason: §4's only evidence that the redrawn panels equal the IDS rests on an artifact a later reader cannot open, so the node should commit the check (or §4 should name a durable path for it) or the same durability gap that §2 was marked down for recurs and the element measure is unverifiable from the repository.
findings.text: §4's done-when depends on "The check from §2 … re-run", but §2's own landed record (`docs/evidence/archive/jt60sa-signal-figures-from-ids-landed.html`) states "The check script ran from the worker's scratch directory, so its logs are the record", and its independent review scored durability 12/20 for exactly this ("the element check lives in /tmp scratch and no committed gate guards the figure calls"); no committed check exists (no test or script under `tests/` or `scripts/` performs the panel-vs-IDS equality check), so §4 presupposes re-using a check whose source is already gone and does not require it to be committed

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `jt60sa-pulse-ids.html#s8`, the `jt60sa-differential-flux-loops` decision, `scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py`, `imas_ink.extract_signal_traces` and the DD path all resolve; the one unresolved name is the §2 check, raised under evidence_paths.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §4 names a measurable done-when (27 panels, FL7 first then the 26 differential entries in index order, byte-identical coil-current and probe SVGs, element-for-element equality) and a declared negative control (negating one differential panel before the figure call fails its equality check).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: a finding — §4's central check is "the check from §2", which by §2's own record ran from a worker scratch directory and is not committed anywhere, so the plan names a check no later reader can open.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags reach symbols or comments; `FL<L>-FL7` are IDS names and ψ_L is physics notation.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §4's body asserts the section is deferred until §8 lands, but its own record (79c4ebbb, f-jsfi-004) treats §8's rewrite as merged, so the section contradicts the state it was released into.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §4 carries one deliverable, the flux-loop SVG redraw from the differential entries.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the section's `jt60sa-pulse-ids#s8` dependency and the plan's `imas-ink:ids-signal-traces` dependency both name nodes that exist; no relationship points at the wrong node.
